gloss: to continue; to persist; to carry on

definitions.gloss: to continue; to persist; to carry on; to maintain
definitions.explanation: To keep doing something or to maintain a state without interruption. Often used in formal or written contexts for sustained activities, policies, or conditions.

examples.japanese: ⟦{努力|どりょく}→努力：03490_doryoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{継続|けいぞく}する。
⟦{治療|ちりょう}→治療：03503_chiryou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{半年間|はんとしかん}{継続|けいぞく}する⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Treatment needs to continue for six months.

examples.japanese: ⟦{景気|けいき}→景気：02694_keiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{回復|かいふく}→回復：03812_kaifuku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{継続|けいぞく}して⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。

⟦{継続|けいぞく}は{力|ちから}なり→継続は力なり：20457_keizokuhachikaranari⟧⟦という→という：09577_toiu⟧⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{通|とお}り→通り：01475_toori⟧、⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧⟦ずつ→〜ずつ：03092_zutsu⟧で⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{勉強|べんきょう}→勉強：00770_benkyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{続|つづ}ける→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧だ。
examples.english: As the saying 'persistence is power' goes, it's important to study a little bit every day.

notes:
Composed of {継|けい} (succeed, inherit) and {続|ぞく} (continue). More formal than ⟦{続|つづ}ける→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧ and often used in written language, business, and official contexts. The proverb ⟦{継続|けいぞく}は{力|ちから}なり→継続は力なり：20457_keizokuhachikaranari⟧ ('persistence is power') is one of the most commonly cited Japanese proverbs.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{努力|どりょく}→努力：03490_doryoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{継続|けいぞく}する: to continue one's efforts
- ⟦{治療|ちりょう}→治療：03503_chiryou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{継続|けいぞく}する: to continue treatment
- ⟦{契約|けいやく}→契約：02698_keiyaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{継続|けいぞく}する: to continue a contract
- ⟦{継続|けいぞく}{的|てき}→継続的：05845_keizokuteki⟧な: continuous, ongoing
- ⟦{継続|けいぞく}は{力|ちから}なり→継続は力なり：20457_keizokuhachikaranari⟧: persistence is power (proverb)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{続|つづ}ける→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧: to continue — everyday verb; more casual and versatile
- ⟦{持続|じぞく}する→持続する：26920_jizokusuru⟧: to sustain, maintain — emphasizes maintaining something at a consistent level
- ⟦{存続|そんぞく}→存続：12242_sonzoku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to survive, continue to exist — focuses on the continued existence of an organization or system
